CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.accept_friend_request(request_id uuid, shares_bulk boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update public.friend_requests
  set
    status = 'accepted',
    recipient_shares_bulk = coalesce(shares_bulk, false)
  where id = request_id
    and recipient_id = auth.uid()
    and status = 'pending';

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Pending friend request was not found.';
  end if;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.activate_store_reward_campaign(p_store_id uuid, p_reserved_tokens integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(ok boolean, campaign_id uuid, store_id uuid, available_tokens integer, reserved_giveaway_tokens integer, reserved_tokens integer, daily_reward_amount integer, duration_days integer, start_date date, end_date date, active boolean, remaining_reserved_tokens integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  active_store_id uuid;
  wallet public.store_token_wallets;
  campaign public.store_reward_campaigns;
  today date := (now() at time zone 'utc')::date;
begin
  if current_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication is required to activate a reward campaign.'
      using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  if not public.is_store_owner_or_admin(p_store_id) then
    raise exception 'Only store owners can activate reward campaigns.'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  select stores.id
  into active_store_id
  from public.stores
  where stores.id = p_store_id
    and stores.is_active;

  if active_store_id is null then
    raise exception 'Reward campaigns require an active store.'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  if p_reserved_tokens is null
    or p_reserved_tokens <= 0
    or p_reserved_tokens % 30 <> 0
  then
    raise exception 'Reserved tokens must be a positive multiple of 30.'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  insert into public.store_token_wallets (store_id)
  values (p_store_id)
  on conflict (store_id) do nothing;

  select *
  into wallet
  from public.store_token_wallets
  where store_token_wallets.store_id = p_store_id
  for update;

  perform public.reconcile_store_reward_campaigns(p_store_id);

  select *
  into wallet
  from public.store_token_wallets
  where store_token_wallets.store_id = p_store_id
  for update;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.store_reward_campaigns
    where store_reward_campaigns.store_id = p_store_id
      and store_reward_campaigns.active
  ) then
    raise exception 'This store already has an active reward campaign.'
      using errcode = '23505';
  end if;

  if wallet.available_tokens < p_reserved_tokens then
    raise exception 'Store does not have enough available tokens for this campaign.'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  update public.store_token_wallets
  set
    available_tokens = available_tokens - p_reserved_tokens,
    reserved_giveaway_tokens = reserved_giveaway_tokens + p_reserved_tokens,
    lifetime_reserved = lifetime_reserved + p_reserved_tokens
  where store_token_wallets.store_id = p_store_id
  returning * into wallet;

  insert into public.store_reward_campaigns (
    store_id,
    reserved_tokens,
    daily_reward_amount,
    duration_days,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    active,
    remaining_reserved_tokens,
    created_by
  )
  values (
    p_store_id,
    p_reserved_tokens,
    p_reserved_tokens / 30,
    30,
    today,
    today + 29,
    true,
    p_reserved_tokens,
    current_user_id
  )
  returning * into campaign;

  return query
  select
    true,
    campaign.id,
    campaign.store_id,
    wallet.available_tokens,
    wallet.reserved_giveaway_tokens,
    campaign.reserved_tokens,
    campaign.daily_reward_amount,
    campaign.duration_days,
    campaign.start_date,
    campaign.end_date,
    campaign.active,
    campaign.remaining_reserved_tokens;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.build_daily_feature_fallback_digest_items(p_run_id uuid, p_run_date date, p_timezone text)
 RETURNS TABLE(inserted_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  normalized_timezone text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_timezone, '')), '');
  affected_count integer := 0;
begin
  if auth.role() <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception 'Only the service role can build daily feature fallback digest items.'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if normalized_timezone is null or char_length(normalized_timezone) > 64 then
    raise exception 'A valid notification digest timezone is required.'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.notification_digest_runs
    where notification_digest_runs.id = p_run_id
      and notification_digest_runs.run_date = p_run_date
      and notification_digest_runs.timezone = normalized_timezone
  ) then
    raise exception 'Notification digest run was not found for the requested date and timezone.'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  insert into public.notification_digest_items (
    run_id,
    user_id,
    event_id,
    digest_date,
    timezone,
    section,
    rank
  )
  select
    p_run_id,
    notification_events.recipient_user_id,
    notification_events.id,
    p_run_date,
    normalized_timezone,
    'deck_sage',
    1
  from public.notification_events
  where notification_events.event_type = 'deck_sage_daily_feature'
    and notification_events.event_date = p_run_date
    and notification_events.timezone = normalized_timezone
    and (
      notification_events.expires_at is null
      or notification_events.expires_at > now()
    )
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.notification_digest_items existing_items
      join public.notification_events existing_events
        on existing_events.id = existing_items.event_id
      where existing_items.user_id = notification_events.recipient_user_id
        and existing_items.run_id = p_run_id
        and existing_items.digest_date = p_run_date
        and existing_events.event_type <> 'deck_sage_daily_feature'
    )
  on conflict (user_id, event_id, digest_date)
  do nothing;

  get diagnostics affected_count = row_count;

  return query
  select affected_count;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bulk_deck_analysis_expire_stale(p_user_id uuid, p_reservation_month date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  expired_count integer;
begin
  update public.bulk_deck_analysis_requests requests
  set status = 'expired',
      expired_at = clock_timestamp(),
      terminal_code = 'RESERVATION_EXPIRED'
  where requests.user_id = p_user_id
    and requests.status = 'processing'
    and requests.expires_at <= clock_timestamp()
    and (p_reservation_month is null
      or requests.reservation_month = p_reservation_month);
  get diagnostics expired_count = row_count;
  return expired_count;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_in_to_store(p_store_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(ok boolean, already_checked_in boolean, store_id uuid, store_name text, checked_in_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  active_store record;
  inserted_checkin record;
  existing_checkin record;
  checkin_date date := (now() at time zone 'utc')::date;
begin
  if current_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication is required to check in to a store.'
      using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  select stores.id, stores.name
  into active_store
  from public.stores
  where stores.id = p_store_id
    and stores.is_public
    and stores.is_active;

  if active_store.id is null then
    raise exception 'This store check-in link is no longer active.'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  insert into public.store_checkins (
    store_id,
    user_id,
    visit_reason,
    looking_for_commander_game,
    commander_game_status,
    decks_brought,
    checked_in_at,
    check_in_date,
    source
  )
  values (
    active_store.id,
    current_user_id,
    'general',
    false,
    'not_looking',
    '[]'::jsonb,
    now(),
    checkin_date,
    'qr'
  )
  on conflict (store_id, user_id, check_in_date) do nothing
  returning store_checkins.checked_in_at
  into inserted_checkin;

  if inserted_checkin.checked_in_at is not null then
    return query
    select
      true,
      false,
      active_store.id,
      active_store.name,
      inserted_checkin.checked_in_at;
    return;
  end if;

  select store_checkins.checked_in_at
  into existing_checkin
  from public.store_checkins
  where store_checkins.store_id = active_store.id
    and store_checkins.user_id = current_user_id
    and store_checkins.check_in_date = checkin_date
  order by store_checkins.checked_in_at asc
  limit 1;

  return query
  select
    true,
    true,
    active_store.id,
    active_store.name,
    existing_checkin.checked_in_at;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_ready_notification_digest_deliveries(p_limit integer DEFAULT 100, p_digest_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_timezone text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_claim_id uuid DEFAULT extensions.gen_random_uuid())
 RETURNS TABLE(delivery_id uuid, user_id uuid, digest_date date, timezone text, title text, body text, item_count integer, claim_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  normalized_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 100), 1), 100);
  normalized_timezone text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_timezone, '')), '');
  normalized_claim_id uuid := coalesce(p_claim_id, extensions.gen_random_uuid());
begin
  if auth.role() <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception 'Only the service role can claim notification digest deliveries.'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if normalized_timezone is not null and char_length(normalized_timezone) > 64 then
    raise exception 'A valid notification digest timezone is required.'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  return query
  with claimed as (
    select notification_digest_deliveries.id
    from public.notification_digest_deliveries
    where notification_digest_deliveries.status = 'ready'
      and notification_digest_deliveries.attempt_count < 3
      and (p_digest_date is null or notification_digest_deliveries.digest_date = p_digest_date)
      and (normalized_timezone is null or notification_digest_deliveries.timezone = normalized_timezone)
    order by
      notification_digest_deliveries.digest_date asc,
      notification_digest_deliveries.ready_at asc nulls last,
      notification_digest_deliveries.created_at asc
    limit normalized_limit
    for update skip locked
  ),
  updated as (
    update public.notification_digest_deliveries
    set
      status = 'sending',
      claim_id = normalized_claim_id,
      claimed_at = now(),
      last_attempt_at = now(),
      attempt_count = notification_digest_deliveries.attempt_count + 1,
      error_message = null
    from claimed
    where notification_digest_deliveries.id = claimed.id
    returning
      notification_digest_deliveries.id,
      notification_digest_deliveries.user_id,
      notification_digest_deliveries.digest_date,
      notification_digest_deliveries.timezone,
      notification_digest_deliveries.title,
      notification_digest_deliveries.body,
      notification_digest_deliveries.item_count,
      notification_digest_deliveries.claim_id
  )
  select
    updated.id,
    updated.user_id,
    updated.digest_date,
    updated.timezone,
    updated.title,
    updated.body,
    updated.item_count,
    updated.claim_id
  from updated;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_notification_digest_run(p_run_id uuid, p_status text, p_error_message text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(run_id uuid, run_date date, timezone text, status text, candidate_count integer, item_count integer, delivery_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  updated_run record;
begin
  if auth.role() <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception 'Only the service role can complete notification digest runs.'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if p_status not in ('success', 'failed', 'skipped') then
    raise exception 'Digest run completion status must be success, failed, or skipped.'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  update public.notification_digest_runs
  set
    status = p_status,
    completed_at = now(),
    error_message = p_error_message,
    candidate_count = (
      select count(*)::integer
      from public.notification_events
      where notification_events.event_date = notification_digest_runs.run_date
        and notification_events.timezone = notification_digest_runs.timezone
    ),
    item_count = (
      select count(*)::integer
      from public.notification_digest_items
      where notification_digest_items.run_id = notification_digest_runs.id
    ),
    delivery_count = (
      select count(*)::integer
      from public.notification_digest_deliveries
      where notification_digest_deliveries.run_id = notification_digest_runs.id
    )
  where notification_digest_runs.id = p_run_id
  returning
    notification_digest_runs.id,
    notification_digest_runs.run_date,
    notification_digest_runs.timezone,
    notification_digest_runs.status,
    notification_digest_runs.candidate_count,
    notification_digest_runs.item_count,
    notification_digest_runs.delivery_count
  into updated_run;

  if updated_run.id is null then
    raise exception 'Notification digest run was not found.'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    updated_run.id,
    updated_run.run_date,
    updated_run.timezone,
    updated_run.status,
    updated_run.candidate_count,
    updated_run.item_count,
    updated_run.delivery_count;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.connected_match_commander_snapshot(p_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE

AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'participant_id', participants.id,
        'user_id', participants.user_id,
        'commander_name', participants.commander_name,
        'commander_scryfall_id', participants.commander_scryfall_id,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.connected_match_cost_commander_damage_trigger()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' and new.damage > 0 then
    perform public.record_connected_match_cost_event(
      new.session_id,
      new.target_participant_id,
      'commander_damage_updated',
      1,
      true,
      1,
      jsonb_build_object('source_participant_id', new.source_participant_id, 'damage', new.damage)
    );
  elsif tg_op = 'UPDATE' and old.damage is distinct from new.damage then
    perform public.record_connected_match_cost_event(
      new.session_id,
      new.target_participant_id,
      'commander_damage_updated',
      1,
      true,
      1,
      jsonb_build_object('source_participant_id', new.source_participant_id, 'delta', new.damage - old.damage)
    );
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.connected_match_cost_estimate(p_total_writes integer, p_realtime_writes integer, p_heartbeat_count integer, p_include_history_storage boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    public.connected_match_cost_assumption_value('base_connected_game_cost_usd', 0)
    + greatest(coalesce(p_total_writes, 0), 0)
      * public.connected_match_cost_assumption_value('db_write_cost_usd', 0)
    + greatest(coalesce(p_realtime_writes, 0), 0)
      * public.connected_match_cost_assumption_value('realtime_event_cost_usd', 0)
    + greatest(coalesce(p_heartbeat_count, 0), 0)
      * public.connected_match_cost_assumption_value('heartbeat_cost_usd', 0)
    + case
        when p_include_history_storage then
          public.connected_match_cost_assumption_value('history_storage_cost_usd', 0)
        else 0
      end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.connected_match_cost_participants_trigger()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  counter_changed boolean;
  identity_changed boolean;
  timing_changed boolean;
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    perform public.record_connected_match_cost_event(
      new.session_id,
      new.id,
      'participant_joined',
      1,
      true,
      1,
      jsonb_build_object('seat_index', new.seat_index)
    );
    return new;
  end if;

  counter_changed :=
    old.poison is distinct from new.poison
    or old.commander_tax is distinct from new.commander_tax
    or old.energy is distinct from new.energy
    or old.experience is distinct from new.experience
    or old.rad is distinct from new.rad
    or old.ticket is distinct from new.ticket;

  identity_changed :=
    old.display_name is distinct from new.display_name
    or old.avatar_ref is distinct from new.avatar_ref
    or old.commander_name is distinct from new.commander_name
    or old.commander_scryfall_id is distinct from new.commander_scryfall_id
    or old.commander_image_url is distinct from new.commander_image_url
    or old.commander_art_crop_url is distinct from new.commander_art_crop_url;

  timing_changed :=
    old.last_seen_at is distinct from new.last_seen_at
    or old.reconnect_until is distinct from new.reconnect_until;

  if old.life is distinct from new.life then
    perform public.record_connected_match_cost_event(
      new.session_id,
      new.id,
      'life_updated',
      1,
      true,
      1,
      jsonb_build_object('delta', new.life - old.life)
    );
  end if;

  if counter_changed then
    perform public.record_connected_match_cost_event(
      new.session_id,
      new.id,
      'counter_updated',
      1,
      true,
      1,
      '{}'::jsonb
    );
  end if;

  if old.terminal_state is distinct from new.terminal_state then
    perform public.record_connected_match_cost_event(
      new.session_id,
      new.id,
      'terminal_state_set',
      1,
      true,
      1,
      jsonb_build_object('terminal_state', new.terminal_state)
    );
  elsif timing_changed and identity_changed then
    perform public.increment_connected_match_cost_counter(
      new.session_id,
      'participant_reconnected',
      1,
      1,
      true
    );
  elsif timing_changed and not counter_changed and old.life is not distinct from new.life then
    perform public.increment_connected_match_cost_counter(
      new.session_id,
      'heartbeat',
      1,
      1,
      true
    );
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.connected_match_cost_sessions_trigger()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    perform public.record_connected_match_cost_event(
      new.id,
      null,
      'session_created',
      1,
      true,
      1,
      '{}'::jsonb
    );
    return new;
  end if;

  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' and old.status is distinct from new.status then
    if new.status = 'active' then
      perform public.record_connected_match_cost_event(
        new.id,
        new.first_player_participant_id,
        'game_started',
        1,
        true,
        1,
        jsonb_build_object('from_status', old.status, 'to_status', new.status)
      );
    elsif new.status = 'completed' then
      perform public.record_connected_match_cost_event(
        new.id,
        new.winner_participant_id,
        'game_completed',
        1,
        true,
        2,
        jsonb_build_object('from_status', old.status, 'to_status', new.status)
      );
      begin
        perform public.refresh_connected_match_cost_rollup(new.id);
      exception
        when others then
          -- Cost telemetry is beta instrumentation and must never block match completion.
          null;
      end;
    end if;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_connected_match(p_player jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(session jsonb, participant jsonb, monthly_usage jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  player_payload record;
  usage_payload record;
  session_record public.connected_match_sessions;
  participant_record public.connected_match_participants;
begin
  if current_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication is required to create a Connected Match.'
      using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  select *
  into usage_payload
  from public.reserve_connected_match_usage(current_user_id, 'started')
  limit 1;

  select *
  into player_payload
  from public.connected_match_build_player_payload(coalesce(p_player, '{}'::jsonb), current_user_id)
  limit 1;

  insert into public.connected_match_sessions (
    join_code,
    host_user_id,
    expires_at
  )
  values (
    public.generate_connected_match_join_code(),
    current_user_id,
    now() + interval '12 hours'
  )
  returning *
  into session_record;

  insert into public.connected_match_participants (
    session_id,
    user_id,
    seat_index,
    display_name,
    avatar_ref,
    commander_name,
    commander_scryfall_id,
    commander_image_url,
    commander_art_crop_url,
    life,
    is_ready,
    ready_at,
    reconnect_until
  )
  values (
    session_record.id,
    current_user_id,
    0,
    player_payload.display_name,
    player_payload.avatar_ref,
    player_payload.commander_name,
    player_payload.commander_scryfall_id,
    player_payload.commander_image_url,
    player_payload.commander_art_crop_url,
    session_record.starting_life,
    true,
    now(),
    now() + interval '30 minutes'
  )
  returning *
  into participant_record;

  insert into public.connected_match_events (
    session_id,
    participant_id,
    event_type,
    payload
  )
  values (
    session_record.id,
    participant_record.id,
    'session_created',
    jsonb_build_object('user_id', current_user_id)
  );

  session := row_to_json(session_record)::jsonb;
  participant := row_to_json(participant_record)::jsonb;
  monthly_usage := jsonb_build_object(
    'usage_month', usage_payload.usage_month,
    'used_count', usage_payload.used_count,
    'monthly_limit', usage_payload.monthly_limit,
    'remaining_count', usage_payload.remaining_count,
    'entitlement_source', usage_payload.entitlement_source
  );

  return next;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_or_resume_notification_digest_run(p_run_date date DEFAULT ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc'::text))::date, p_timezone text DEFAULT 'UTC'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(run_id uuid, run_date date, timezone text, status text, started_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  normalized_timezone text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_timezone, '')), '');
  digest_run record;
begin
  if auth.role() <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception 'Only the service role can create notification digest runs.'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if normalized_timezone is null or char_length(normalized_timezone) > 64 then
    raise exception 'A valid notification digest timezone is required.'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  begin
    insert into public.notification_digest_runs (run_date, timezone, status)
    values (p_run_date, normalized_timezone, 'running')
    returning
      public.notification_digest_runs.id,
      public.notification_digest_runs.run_date,
      public.notification_digest_runs.timezone,
      public.notification_digest_runs.status,
      public.notification_digest_runs.started_at
    into digest_run;
  exception
    when unique_violation then
      update public.notification_digest_runs as digest_runs
      set
        status = case
          when digest_runs.status in ('failed', 'skipped') then 'running'
          else digest_runs.status
        end,
        error_message = case
          when digest_runs.status in ('failed', 'skipped') then null
          else digest_runs.error_message
        end
      where digest_runs.run_date = p_run_date
        and digest_runs.timezone = normalized_timezone
      returning
        digest_runs.id,
        digest_runs.run_date,
        digest_runs.timezone,
        digest_runs.status,
        digest_runs.started_at
      into digest_run;
  end;

  return query
  select
    digest_run.id,
    digest_run.run_date,
    digest_run.timezone,
    digest_run.status,
    digest_run.started_at;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_commander_pod_ready(p_store_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(ok boolean, pod_ready boolean, player_count integer, players jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  checkin_date date := (now() at time zone 'utc')::date;
  active_store_id uuid;
  caller_is_checked_in boolean;
  connected_count integer := 0;
  connected_players jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
begin
  if current_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication is required to check Commander Pod readiness.'
      using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  select stores.id
  into active_store_id
  from public.stores
  where stores.id = p_store_id
    and stores.is_public
    and stores.is_active;

  if active_store_id is null then
    raise exception 'This store check-in link is no longer active.'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.store_checkins
    where store_checkins.store_id = active_store_id
      and store_checkins.user_id = current_user_id
      and store_checkins.check_in_date = checkin_date
  )
  into caller_is_checked_in;

  if not caller_is_checked_in then
    raise exception 'Check in before checking Commander Pod readiness.'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  with recursive active_players as (
    select distinct store_checkins.user_id
    from public.store_checkins
    where store_checkins.store_id = active_store_id
      and store_checkins.check_in_date = checkin_date
      and store_checkins.looking_for_commander_game
      and store_checkins.commander_game_status = 'looking'
  ),
  recent_edges as (
    select
      store_lfg_interest.requesting_user_id as user_a,
      store_lfg_interest.responding_user_id as user_b
    from public.store_lfg_interest
    join active_players requesting_player
      on requesting_player.user_id = store_lfg_interest.requesting_user_id
    join active_players responding_player
      on responding_player.user_id = store_lfg_interest.responding_user_id
    where store_lfg_interest.store_id = active_store_id
      and store_lfg_interest.interest_date = checkin_date
      and store_lfg_interest.created_at >= now() - interval '15 minutes'
  ),
  connected(user_id) as (
    select current_user_id
    where exists (
      select 1
      from active_players
      where active_players.user_id = current_user_id
    )
    union
    select recent_edges.user_b
    from connected
    join recent_edges
      on recent_edges.user_a = connected.user_id
    union
    select recent_edges.user_a
    from connected
    join recent_edges
      on recent_edges.user_b = connected.user_id
  ),
  connected_profiles as (
    select
      connected.user_id,
      profiles.display_name,
      profiles.username_display as username
    from connected
    join public.profiles
      on profiles.user_id = connected.user_id
    order by coalesce(profiles.display_name, profiles.username_display), profiles.username_display
  )
  select
    count(*)::integer,
    coalesce(
      jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'display_name',
          connected_profiles.display_name,
          'username',
          connected_profiles.username
        )
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    )
  into connected_count, connected_players
  from connected_profiles;

  return query
  select
    true,
    connected_count >= 4,
    connected_count,
    case
      when connected_count >= 4 then connected_players
      else '[]'::jsonb
    end;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_connected_match_cost_admin_summary(p_start_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_end_date date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  start_date date := coalesce(p_start_date, date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'utc')::date);
  end_date date := coalesce(p_end_date, (now() at time zone 'utc')::date);
  current_month date := date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'utc')::date;
  latest_game jsonb;
  highest_cost_game jsonb;
  totals record;
  event_breakdown jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  assumptions jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  daily_totals jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  monthly_totals jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
begin
  if not public.is_super_admin() then
    raise exception 'Super Admin access is required to view Connected Match cost telemetry.'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(assumptions.rate_key, jsonb_build_object(
    'rate_value', assumptions.rate_value,
    'unit', assumptions.unit,
    'cost_model_version', assumptions.cost_model_version,
    'description', assumptions.description
  ) order by assumptions.rate_key), '{}'::jsonb)
  into assumptions
  from public.connected_match_cost_assumptions assumptions
  where assumptions.is_active;

  select row_to_json(rollups)::jsonb
  into latest_game
  from public.connected_match_cost_rollups rollups
  join public.connected_match_sessions sessions
    on sessions.id = rollups.session_id
  where sessions.status = 'completed'
  order by sessions.completed_at desc nulls last, rollups.computed_at desc
  limit 1;

  select row_to_json(rollups)::jsonb
  into highest_cost_game
  from public.connected_match_cost_rollups rollups
  order by rollups.estimated_operational_cost_usd desc, rollups.computed_at desc
  limit 1;

  select
    count(*)::integer as completed_games,
    count(*) filter (where rollups.game_date = (now() at time zone 'utc')::date)::integer as games_today,
    count(*) filter (where rollups.game_month = current_month)::integer as games_this_month,
    coalesce(avg(rollups.participant_count), 0) as average_players_per_game,
    coalesce(avg(rollups.duration_seconds), 0) as average_duration_seconds,
    coalesce(avg(rollups.total_writes), 0) as average_writes_per_game,
    coalesce(avg(rollups.writes_per_minute), 0) as average_writes_per_minute,
    coalesce(avg(rollups.realtime_writes), 0) as average_realtime_writes_per_game,
    coalesce(avg(rollups.heartbeat_count), 0) as average_heartbeats_per_game,
    coalesce(sum(rollups.realtime_writes), 0)::integer as realtime_relevant_writes,
    coalesce(sum(rollups.heartbeat_count), 0)::integer as heartbeat_count,
    coalesce(sum(rollups.reconnect_count), 0)::integer as reconnect_count,
    coalesce(sum(rollups.rpc_action_count), 0)::integer as rpc_action_count,
    coalesce(sum(rollups.estimated_operational_cost_usd), 0) as total_estimated_beta_operational_cost,
    coalesce(sum(rollups.estimated_operational_cost_usd) filter (where rollups.game_month = current_month), 0) as estimated_monthly_connected_match_cost,
    coalesce(avg(rollups.estimated_operational_cost_usd), 0) as average_estimated_operational_cost_per_game
  into totals
  from public.connected_match_cost_rollups rollups
  where rollups.game_date between start_date and end_date;

  select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(event_type, total_units order by event_type), '{}'::jsonb)
  into event_breakdown
  from (
    select
      keys.event_type,
      sum((rollups.event_breakdown ->> keys.event_type)::integer)::integer as total_units
    from public.connected_match_cost_rollups rollups
    cross join lateral jsonb_object_keys(rollups.event_breakdown) as keys(event_type)
    where rollups.game_date between start_date and end_date
    group by keys.event_type
  ) breakdown;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(daily_rows)::jsonb order by daily_rows.game_date), '[]'::jsonb)
  into daily_totals
  from (
    select
      rollups.game_date,
      count(*)::integer as games,
      sum(rollups.estimated_operational_cost_usd) as estimated_operational_cost_usd,
      sum(rollups.total_writes)::integer as total_writes,
      avg(rollups.writes_per_minute) as writes_per_minute
    from public.connected_match_cost_rollups rollups
    where rollups.game_date between start_date and end_date
    group by rollups.game_date
  ) daily_rows;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(monthly_rows)::jsonb order by monthly_rows.game_month), '[]'::jsonb)
  into monthly_totals
  from (
    select
      rollups.game_month,
      count(*)::integer as games,
      sum(rollups.estimated_operational_cost_usd) as estimated_operational_cost_usd,
      sum(rollups.total_writes)::integer as total_writes,
      avg(rollups.writes_per_minute) as writes_per_minute
    from public.connected_match_cost_rollups rollups
    group by rollups.game_month
  ) monthly_rows;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'label', 'Estimated Operational Cost',
    'disclaimer', 'Based on configured assumptions. Not exact billing.',
    'cost_model_version', public.connected_match_cost_model_version(),
    'date_range', jsonb_build_object(
      'start_date', start_date,
      'end_date', end_date
    ),
    'latest_completed_game', coalesce(latest_game, '{}'::jsonb),
    'highest_cost_game', coalesce(highest_cost_game, '{}'::jsonb),
    'average_estimated_operational_cost_per_completed_game', totals.average_estimated_operational_cost_per_game,
    'total_estimated_beta_operational_cost', totals.total_estimated_beta_operational_cost,
    'estimated_monthly_connected_match_cost', totals.estimated_monthly_connected_match_cost,
    'games_today', totals.games_today,
    'games_this_month', totals.games_this_month,
    'completed_games', totals.completed_games,
    'average_players_per_game', totals.average_players_per_game,
    'average_duration_seconds', totals.average_duration_seconds,
    'average_writes_per_game', totals.average_writes_per_game,
    'writes_per_minute', totals.average_writes_per_minute,
    'realtime_relevant_writes', totals.realtime_relevant_writes,
    'average_realtime_writes_per_game', totals.average_realtime_writes_per_game,
    'heartbeats_per_game', totals.average_heartbeats_per_game,
    'heartbeat_count', totals.heartbeat_count,
    'reconnect_count', totals.reconnect_count,
    'rpc_action_count', totals.rpc_action_count,
    'event_breakdown', coalesce(event_breakdown, '{}'::jsonb),
    'daily_totals', daily_totals,
    'monthly_totals', monthly_totals,
    'assumptions', assumptions
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_daily_feature_message_for_date(p_run_date date)
 RETURNS notification_daily_feature_messages
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  message_count integer := 0;
  message_offset integer := 0;
  selected_message public.notification_daily_feature_messages;
begin
  select count(*)::integer
  into message_count
  from public.notification_daily_feature_messages
  where is_active
    and (starts_on is null or starts_on <= p_run_date)
    and (ends_on is null or ends_on >= p_run_date);

  if message_count <= 0 then
    raise exception 'No active daily feature fallback messages are available.'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  message_offset := mod(abs(p_run_date - date '2000-01-01'), message_count);

  select *
  into selected_message
  from public.notification_daily_feature_messages
  where is_active
    and (starts_on is null or starts_on <= p_run_date)
    and (ends_on is null or ends_on >= p_run_date)
  order by message_key asc
  offset message_offset
  limit 1;

  return selected_message;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_shared_bulk_card_owners(card_names text[])

 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER

AS $function$

    select distinct lower(trim(card_name)) as normalized_name
    from unnest(coalesce(card_names, array[]::text[])) as card_name

  ),
  sharing_friends as (

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_store_daily_push_notification_preview(p_store_id uuid, p_days integer DEFAULT 14)
 RETURNS TABLE(store_id uuid, store_name text, message text, enabled boolean, timezone text, message_updated_at timestamp with time zone, eligible_home_store_user_count integer, digest_date date, run_id uuid, run_status text, event_count integer, item_count integer, prepared_delivery_count integer, ready_delivery_count integer, sent_delivery_count integer, failed_delivery_count integer, skipped_delivery_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  normalized_days integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_days, 14), 1), 60);
  selected_store record;
begin
  if current_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication is required to preview Store Daily Push notifications.'
      using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  if not public.is_store_staff(p_store_id) then
    raise exception 'You are not authorized to preview Store Daily Push notifications for this store.'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  select
    stores.id,
    stores.name,
    stores.store_daily_push_message,
    stores.store_daily_push_message_enabled,
    stores.store_daily_push_message_updated_at,
    stores.timezone,
    stores.is_active,
    stores.is_public
  into selected_store
  from public.stores
  where stores.id = p_store_id;

  if selected_store.id is null then
    raise exception 'Store was not found.'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  return query
  with local_dates as (
    select
      (
        (now() at time zone selected_store.timezone)::date
        - offsets.day_offset
      )::date as digest_date
    from generate_series(0, normalized_days - 1) as offsets(day_offset)
  ),
  eligible_users as (
    select count(*)::integer as eligible_count
    from public.player_store_preferences
    left join public.notification_preferences
      on notification_preferences.user_id = player_store_preferences.user_id
    where player_store_preferences.home_store_id = selected_store.id
      and selected_store.is_active
      and selected_store.is_public
      and selected_store.store_daily_push_message_enabled
      and nullif(btrim(selected_store.store_daily_push_message), '') is not null
      and coalesce(notification_preferences.digest_enabled, true)
      and coalesce(notification_preferences.home_store_daily_message_enabled, true)
  ),
  store_events as (
    select
      notification_events.id,
      notification_events.recipient_user_id,
      notification_events.event_date,
      notification_events.timezone
    from public.notification_events
    where notification_events.store_id = selected_store.id
      and notification_events.event_type = 'home_store_daily_message'
      and notification_events.timezone = selected_store.timezone
      and notification_events.event_date >= (
        select min(local_dates.digest_date)
        from local_dates
      )
  ),
  store_items as (
    select
      digest_items.id,
      digest_items.user_id,
      digest_items.digest_date,
      digest_items.timezone
    from public.notification_digest_items digest_items
    join store_events
      on store_events.id = digest_items.event_id
    where digest_items.section = 'home_store'
  ),
  store_deliveries as (
    select distinct
      deliveries.id,
      deliveries.digest_date,
      deliveries.timezone,
      deliveries.status
    from public.notification_digest_deliveries deliveries
    join store_items
      on store_items.user_id = deliveries.user_id
     and store_items.digest_date = deliveries.digest_date
     and store_items.timezone = deliveries.timezone
  )
  select
    selected_store.id as store_id,
    selected_store.name as store_name,
    selected_store.store_daily_push_message as message,
    selected_store.store_daily_push_message_enabled as enabled,
    selected_store.timezone,
    selected_store.store_daily_push_message_updated_at as message_updated_at,
    eligible_users.eligible_count as eligible_home_store_user_count,
    local_dates.digest_date,
    digest_runs.id as run_id,
    digest_runs.status as run_status,
    coalesce(count(distinct store_events.id), 0)::integer as event_count,
    coalesce(count(distinct store_items.id), 0)::integer as item_count,
    coalesce(count(distinct store_deliveries.id), 0)::integer as prepared_delivery_count,
    coalesce(count(distinct store_deliveries.id) filter (where store_deliveries.status = 'ready'), 0)::integer as ready_delivery_count,
    coalesce(count(distinct store_deliveries.id) filter (where store_deliveries.status = 'sent'), 0)::integer as sent_delivery_count,
    coalesce(count(distinct store_deliveries.id) filter (where store_deliveries.status = 'failed'), 0)::integer as failed_delivery_count,
    coalesce(count(distinct store_deliveries.id) filter (where store_deliveries.status = 'skipped'), 0)::integer as skipped_delivery_count
  from local_dates
  cross join eligible_users
  left join public.notification_digest_runs digest_runs
    on digest_runs.run_date = local_dates.digest_date
   and digest_runs.timezone = selected_store.timezone
  left join store_events
    on store_events.event_date = local_dates.digest_date
   and store_events.timezone = selected_store.timezone
  left join store_items
    on store_items.digest_date = local_dates.digest_date
   and store_items.timezone = selected_store.timezone
  left join store_deliveries
    on store_deliveries.digest_date = local_dates.digest_date
   and store_deliveries.timezone = selected_store.timezone
  group by
    selected_store.id,
    selected_store.name,
    selected_store.store_daily_push_message,
    selected_store.store_daily_push_message_enabled,
    selected_store.timezone,
    selected_store.store_daily_push_message_updated_at,
    eligible_users.eligible_count,
    local_dates.digest_date,
    digest_runs.id,
    digest_runs.status
  order by local_dates.digest_date desc;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_store_lfg_today(p_store_id uuid)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_store_reward_campaign_status(p_store_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(store_id uuid, available_tokens integer, reserved_giveaway_tokens integer, campaign_id uuid, reserved_tokens integer, daily_reward_amount integer, duration_days integer, start_date date, end_date date, active boolean, remaining_reserved_tokens integer, days_remaining integer, today_winner_user_id uuid, today_winner_display_name text, today_winner_username text, today_winner_token_amount integer, today_winner_selected_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  today date := (now() at time zone 'utc')::date;
begin
  if not public.is_store_staff(p_store_id) then
    raise exception 'You are not authorized to read this store reward campaign.'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  insert into public.store_token_wallets (store_id)
  values (p_store_id)
  on conflict (store_id) do nothing;

  perform public.reconcile_store_reward_campaigns(p_store_id);

  return query
  select
    wallets.store_id,
    wallets.available_tokens,
    wallets.reserved_giveaway_tokens,
    campaign.id,
    campaign.reserved_tokens,
    campaign.daily_reward_amount,
    campaign.duration_days,
    campaign.start_date,
    campaign.end_date,
    campaign.active,
    campaign.remaining_reserved_tokens,
    case
      when campaign.id is null then null
      else greatest(campaign.end_date - today + 1, 0)
    end as days_remaining,
    award.user_id,
    profiles.display_name,
    profiles.username_display,
    award.token_amount,
    award.selected_at

  left join lateral (

    from public.store_reward_campaigns
    where store_reward_campaigns.store_id = wallets.store_id
      and store_reward_campaigns.active
    order by store_reward_campaigns.created_at desc
    limit 1
  ) campaign on true
  left join public.store_reward_campaign_daily_awards award
    on award.campaign_id = campaign.id
    and award.reward_date = today
  left join public.profiles
    on profiles.user_id = award.user_id
  where wallets.store_id = p_store_id;

begin

    or new.store_daily_push_message_updated_at is distinct from old.store_daily_push_message_updated_at
    or new.store_daily_push_last_sent_date is distinct from old.store_daily_push_last_sent_date

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_connected_match_cost_counter(p_session_id uuid, p_counter_key text, p_units integer DEFAULT 1, p_estimated_write_count integer DEFAULT 1, p_is_realtime_relevant boolean DEFAULT true)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  session_record public.connected_match_sessions;
  counter_name text := btrim(coalesce(p_counter_key, ''));
  units integer := greatest(coalesce(p_units, 1), 1);
  write_count integer := greatest(coalesce(p_estimated_write_count, 0), 0);
begin
  if not public.connected_match_cost_telemetry_enabled() then
    return;
  end if;

  if p_session_id is null or counter_name not in ('heartbeat', 'participant_reconnected') then
    return;
  end if;

  select *
  into session_record
  from public.connected_match_sessions sessions
  where sessions.id = p_session_id;

  if session_record.id is null then
    return;
  end if;

  insert into public.connected_match_cost_rollups (
    session_id,
    game_date,
    game_month,
    participant_count,
    total_writes,
    realtime_writes,
    heartbeat_count,
    reconnect_count,
    event_breakdown,
    cost_model_version,
    computed_at
  )
  values (
    p_session_id,
    (session_record.created_at at time zone 'utc')::date,
    date_trunc('month', session_record.created_at at time zone 'utc')::date,
    (
      select count(*)::integer
      from public.connected_match_participants participants
      where participants.session_id = p_session_id
    ),
    write_count,
    case when coalesce(p_is_realtime_relevant, true) then write_count else 0 end,
    case when counter_name = 'heartbeat' then units else 0 end,
    case when counter_name = 'participant_reconnected' then units else 0 end,
    jsonb_build_object(counter_name, units),
    public.connected_match_cost_model_version(),
    now()
  )
  on conflict (session_id) do update set
    participant_count = (
      select count(*)::integer
      from public.connected_match_participants participants
      where participants.session_id = excluded.session_id
    ),
    total_writes = connected_match_cost_rollups.total_writes + excluded.total_writes,
    realtime_writes = connected_match_cost_rollups.realtime_writes + excluded.realtime_writes,
    heartbeat_count = connected_match_cost_rollups.heartbeat_count + excluded.heartbeat_count,
    reconnect_count = connected_match_cost_rollups.reconnect_count + excluded.reconnect_count,
    event_breakdown = public.connected_match_cost_increment_breakdown(
      connected_match_cost_rollups.event_breakdown,
      counter_name,
      units
    ),
    cost_model_version = public.connected_match_cost_model_version(),
    computed_at = now();
exception
  when others then
    -- Telemetry is best-effort and must never break active gameplay.
    return;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_active_news_run(input_run_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.leave_connected_match_lobby(p_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  session_record public.connected_match_sessions;
  participant_record public.connected_match_participants;
  next_host_user_id uuid;
  remaining_active_count integer;
begin
  if current_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication is required to leave a Connected Match lobby.'
      using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  select *
  into session_record
  from public.connected_match_sessions sessions
  where sessions.id = p_session_id
  for update;

  if session_record.id is null then
    raise exception 'Connected Match not found.'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  if session_record.status <> 'lobby' then
    raise exception 'Only lobby sessions can be left this way.'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  update public.connected_match_participants participants
  set
    terminal_state = 'left',
    elimination_reason = 'left',
    left_mid_game = true,
    is_ready = false,
    ready_at = null,
    last_seen_at = now(),
    reconnect_until = now() + interval '30 minutes'
  where participants.session_id = p_session_id
    and participants.user_id = current_user_id
  returning *
  into participant_record;

  if participant_record.id is null then
    raise exception 'You are not part of this Connected Match lobby.'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  select count(*)
  into remaining_active_count
  from public.connected_match_participants participants
  where participants.session_id = p_session_id
    and participants.terminal_state = 'active';

  if remaining_active_count = 0 then
    update public.connected_match_sessions
    set
      status = 'abandoned',
      completed_at = now(),
      expires_at = now()
    where id = p_session_id;
  elsif session_record.host_user_id = current_user_id then
    select participants.user_id
    into next_host_user_id
    from public.connected_match_participants participants
    where participants.session_id = p_session_id
      and participants.terminal_state = 'active'
    order by participants.seat_index
    limit 1;

    update public.connected_match_sessions
    set host_user_id = next_host_user_id
    where id = p_session_id;
  end if;

  insert into public.connected_match_events (
    session_id,
    participant_id,
    event_type,
    payload
  )
  values (
    p_session_id,
    participant_record.id,
    'lobby_participant_left',
    jsonb_build_object('user_id', current_user_id)
  );

  return row_to_json(participant_record)::jsonb;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_store_daily_push_sent(p_store_id uuid, p_sent_date date DEFAULT ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc'::text))::date)
 RETURNS TABLE(store_id uuid, last_sent_date date)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  updated_store record;
begin
  if auth.role() <> 'service_role'
    and public.current_user_role() not in ('Admin', 'SuperAdmin')
  then
    raise exception 'You are not authorized to mark Store Daily Push messages sent.'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  update public.stores
  set store_daily_push_last_sent_date = p_sent_date
  where stores.id = p_store_id
    and stores.is_active
    and (
      stores.store_daily_push_last_sent_date is null
      or stores.store_daily_push_last_sent_date < p_sent_date
    )
  returning
    stores.id,
    stores.store_daily_push_last_sent_date
  into updated_store;

  if updated_store.id is null then
    raise exception 'Store Daily Push message was already marked sent for this date or store is inactive.'
      using errcode = '23505';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    updated_store.id,
    updated_store.store_daily_push_last_sent_date;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prepare_notification_digest_deliveries(p_run_id uuid, p_run_date date DEFAULT ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc'::text))::date, p_timezone text DEFAULT 'UTC'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(inserted_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  normalized_timezone text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_timezone, '')), '');
  affected_count integer := 0;
begin
  if auth.role() <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception 'Only the service role can prepare notification digest deliveries.'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if normalized_timezone is null or char_length(normalized_timezone) > 64 then
    raise exception 'A valid notification digest timezone is required.'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.notification_digest_runs
    where notification_digest_runs.id = p_run_id
      and notification_digest_runs.run_date = p_run_date
      and notification_digest_runs.timezone = normalized_timezone
  ) then
    raise exception 'Notification digest run was not found for the requested date and timezone.'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  insert into public.notification_digest_deliveries (
    run_id,
    user_id,
    digest_date,
    timezone,
    status,
    title,
    body,
    item_count,
    ready_at
  )
  select
    p_run_id,
    digest_items.user_id,
    p_run_date,
    normalized_timezone,
    'ready',
    'Your Deck Sage digest',
    case
      when count(*) = 1 then max(notification_events.body)
      else 'You have ' || count(*)::text || ' Deck Sage updates.'
    end,
    count(*)::integer,
    now()
  from public.notification_digest_items digest_items
  join public.notification_events
    on notification_events.id = digest_items.event_id
  where digest_items.run_id = p_run_id
    and digest_items.digest_date = p_run_date
    and digest_items.timezone = normalized_timezone
  group by digest_items.user_id
  on conflict (user_id, digest_date)
  do nothing;

  get diagnostics affected_count = row_count;

  return query
  select affected_count;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pull_cloud_deck_changes(cursor_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, cursor_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, limit_count integer DEFAULT 250)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  acting_owner_id uuid := auth.uid();
  safe_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(limit_count, 250), 1), 250);
  deck_rows jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  commander_rows jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  card_stack_rows jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  next_cursor_at timestamptz := cursor_at;
  next_cursor_id uuid := cursor_id;
  has_more boolean := false;
begin
  if acting_owner_id is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication is required.'
      using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  with affected_decks as (
    select
      d.id,
      greatest(
        d.server_updated_at,
        coalesce(max(dc.server_updated_at), d.server_updated_at),
        coalesce(max(dcs.server_updated_at), d.server_updated_at)
      ) as deck_revision
    from public.cloud_decks d
    left join public.cloud_deck_commanders dc
      on dc.owner_id = d.owner_id
      and dc.deck_id = d.id
    left join public.cloud_deck_card_stacks dcs
      on dcs.owner_id = d.owner_id
      and dcs.deck_id = d.id
    where d.owner_id = acting_owner_id
    group by d.id, d.server_updated_at
  ),
  changed_decks as (
    select id, deck_revision
    from affected_decks
    where cursor_at is null
      or deck_revision > cursor_at
      or (deck_revision = cursor_at and id > cursor_id)
    order by deck_revision asc, id asc
    limit (safe_limit + 1)
  ),
  page_decks as (
    select id, deck_revision
    from changed_decks
    order by deck_revision asc, id asc
    limit safe_limit
  ),
  cursor_row as (
    select id, deck_revision
    from page_decks
    order by deck_revision desc, id desc
    limit 1
  )
  select
    coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        to_jsonb(d) || jsonb_build_object('deck_revision', pd.deck_revision)
        order by pd.deck_revision asc, d.id asc
      )
      from page_decks pd
      join public.cloud_decks d on d.id = pd.id
      where d.owner_id = acting_owner_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(dc) order by dc.deck_local_id asc, dc.sort_order asc, dc.id asc)
      from page_decks pd
      join public.cloud_deck_commanders dc
        on dc.deck_id = pd.id
        and dc.owner_id = acting_owner_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(dcs) order by dcs.deck_local_id asc, dcs.card_name asc, dcs.id asc)
      from page_decks pd
      join public.cloud_deck_card_stacks dcs
        on dcs.deck_id = pd.id
        and dcs.owner_id = acting_owner_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    coalesce((select deck_revision from cursor_row), cursor_at),
    coalesce((select id from cursor_row), cursor_id),
    (select count(*) > safe_limit from changed_decks)
  into
    deck_rows,
    commander_rows,
    card_stack_rows,
    next_cursor_at,
    next_cursor_id,
    has_more;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'decks', deck_rows,
    'commanders', commander_rows,
    'card_stacks', card_stack_rows,
    'next_cursor', jsonb_build_object(
      'at', next_cursor_at,
      'id', next_cursor_id
    ),
    'has_more', has_more
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.push_cloud_deck_snapshot(deck_payload jsonb, commander_payloads jsonb, card_stack_payloads jsonb, is_full_snapshot boolean, expected_commander_count integer, expected_card_stack_count integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  acting_owner_id uuid := auth.uid();
  sync_revision timestamptz := transaction_timestamp();
  deck_cloud_id uuid;
  deck_local_id text;
  deck_status text;
  deck_server_updated_at timestamptz;
  commander_record jsonb;
  card_record jsonb;
  commander_local_ids text[] := array[]::text[];
  card_stack_local_ids text[] := array[]::text[];
  actual_commander_count integer;
  actual_card_stack_count integer;
  tombstoned_commanders integer := 0;
  tombstoned_card_stacks integer := 0;
begin
  if acting_owner_id is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication is required.'
      using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  if is_full_snapshot is not true then
    raise exception 'push_cloud_deck_snapshot requires a full snapshot.'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  if jsonb_typeof(coalesce(commander_payloads, 'null'::jsonb)) <> 'array' then
    raise exception 'commander_payloads must be a JSON array.'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  if jsonb_typeof(coalesce(card_stack_payloads, 'null'::jsonb)) <> 'array' then
    raise exception 'card_stack_payloads must be a JSON array.'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  actual_commander_count := jsonb_array_length(commander_payloads);
  actual_card_stack_count := jsonb_array_length(card_stack_payloads);

  if expected_commander_count is null or expected_commander_count < 0 then
    raise exception 'expected_commander_count must be a nonnegative integer.'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  if expected_card_stack_count is null or expected_card_stack_count < 0 then
    raise exception 'expected_card_stack_count must be a nonnegative integer.'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  if actual_commander_count <> expected_commander_count then
    raise exception 'Commander payload count does not match expected count.'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  if actual_card_stack_count <> expected_card_stack_count then
    raise exception 'Card stack payload count does not match expected count.'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  deck_local_id := nullif(btrim(deck_payload ->> 'local_id'), '');
  deck_status := coalesce(nullif(deck_payload ->> 'status', ''), 'active');

  if deck_local_id is null then
    raise exception 'Deck local_id is required.'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  if deck_status not in ('active', 'archived', 'deleted') then
    raise exception 'Invalid deck status.'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  if deck_status in ('active', 'archived')
    and (actual_commander_count <> expected_commander_count
      or actual_card_stack_count <> expected_card_stack_count) then
    raise exception 'Active or archived deck payload counts must match expected counts.'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  insert into public.cloud_decks (
    owner_id,
    local_id,
    name,
    commander_name,
    status,
    basic_lands,
    sync_status,
    client_updated_at,
    last_synced_at,
    deleted_at
  )
  values (
    acting_owner_id,
    deck_local_id,
    coalesce(nullif(deck_payload ->> 'name', ''), 'Untitled Deck'),
    coalesce(deck_payload ->> 'commander_name', ''),
    deck_status,
    coalesce(deck_payload -> 'basic_lands', '{}'::jsonb),
    coalesce(nullif(deck_payload ->> 'sync_status', ''), 'synced'),
    coalesce(nullif(deck_payload ->> 'client_updated_at', '')::timestamptz, sync_revision),
    nullif(deck_payload ->> 'last_synced_at', '')::timestamptz,
    case
      when deck_status = 'deleted' then coalesce(nullif(deck_payload ->> 'deleted_at', '')::timestamptz, sync_revision)
      else nullif(deck_payload ->> 'deleted_at', '')::timestamptz
    end
  )
  on conflict (owner_id, local_id)
  do update set
    name = excluded.name,
    commander_name = excluded.commander_name,
    status = excluded.status,
    basic_lands = excluded.basic_lands,
    sync_status = excluded.sync_status,
    client_updated_at = excluded.client_updated_at,
    last_synced_at = excluded.last_synced_at,
    deleted_at = excluded.deleted_at
  returning id, server_updated_at
  into deck_cloud_id, deck_server_updated_at;

  for commander_record in
    select value from jsonb_array_elements(commander_payloads)
  loop
    if nullif(btrim(commander_record ->> 'local_id'), '') is null then
      raise exception 'Commander local_id is required.'
        using errcode = '23514';
    end if;

    commander_local_ids := array_append(
      commander_local_ids,
      commander_record ->> 'local_id'
    );

    insert into public.cloud_deck_commanders (
      owner_id,
      deck_id,
      deck_local_id,
      local_id,
      name,
      normalized_name,
      oracle_id,
      scryfall_id,
      role,
      sort_order,
      sync_status,
      client_updated_at,
      last_synced_at,
      deleted_at
    )
    values (
      acting_owner_id,
      deck_cloud_id,
      deck_local_id,
      commander_record ->> 'local_id',
      coalesce(nullif(commander_record ->> 'name', ''), 'Unknown Commander'),
      coalesce(nullif(commander_record ->> 'normalized_name', ''), lower(coalesce(commander_record ->> 'name', ''))),
      nullif(commander_record ->> 'oracle_id', ''),
      nullif(commander_record ->> 'scryfall_id', ''),
      coalesce(nullif(commander_record ->> 'role', ''), 'other'),
      coalesce(nullif(commander_record ->> 'sort_order', '')::integer, 0),
      coalesce(nullif(commander_record ->> 'sync_status', ''), 'synced'),
      coalesce(nullif(commander_record ->> 'client_updated_at', '')::timestamptz, sync_revision),
      nullif(commander_record ->> 'last_synced_at', '')::timestamptz,
      nullif(commander_record ->> 'deleted_at', '')::timestamptz
    )
    on conflict (owner_id, local_id)
    do update set
      deck_id = excluded.deck_id,
      deck_local_id = excluded.deck_local_id,
      name = excluded.name,
      normalized_name = excluded.normalized_name,
      oracle_id = excluded.oracle_id,
      scryfall_id = excluded.scryfall_id,
      role = excluded.role,
      sort_order = excluded.sort_order,
      sync_status = excluded.sync_status,
      client_updated_at = excluded.client_updated_at,
      last_synced_at = excluded.last_synced_at,
      deleted_at = excluded.deleted_at;
  end loop;

  update public.cloud_deck_commanders
  set
    sync_status = 'deleted',
    deleted_at = coalesce(deleted_at, sync_revision),
    client_updated_at = greatest(client_updated_at, sync_revision)
  where owner_id = acting_owner_id
    and deck_id = deck_cloud_id
    and deleted_at is null
    and (
      deck_status = 'deleted'
      or not (local_id = any(commander_local_ids))
    );

  get diagnostics tombstoned_commanders = row_count;

  for card_record in
    select value from jsonb_array_elements(card_stack_payloads)
  loop
    if nullif(btrim(card_record ->> 'local_id'), '') is null then
      raise exception 'Card stack local_id is required.'
        using errcode = '23514';
    end if;

    card_stack_local_ids := array_append(
      card_stack_local_ids,
      card_record ->> 'local_id'
    );

    insert into public.cloud_deck_card_stacks (
      owner_id,
      deck_id,
      deck_local_id,
      local_id,
      card_name,
      normalized_name,
      oracle_id,
      scryfall_id,
      variant,
      quantity,
      sync_status,
      client_updated_at,
      last_synced_at,
      deleted_at
    )
    values (
      acting_owner_id,
      deck_cloud_id,
      deck_local_id,
      card_record ->> 'local_id',
      coalesce(nullif(card_record ->> 'card_name', ''), 'Unknown Card'),
      coalesce(nullif(card_record ->> 'normalized_name', ''), lower(coalesce(card_record ->> 'card_name', ''))),
      nullif(card_record ->> 'oracle_id', ''),
      nullif(card_record ->> 'scryfall_id', ''),
      coalesce(nullif(card_record ->> 'variant', ''), 'Normal'),
      greatest(0, coalesce(nullif(card_record ->> 'quantity', '')::integer, 0)),
      coalesce(nullif(card_record ->> 'sync_status', ''), 'synced'),
      coalesce(nullif(card_record ->> 'client_updated_at', '')::timestamptz, sync_revision),
      nullif(card_record ->> 'last_synced_at', '')::timestamptz,
      nullif(card_record ->> 'deleted_at', '')::timestamptz
    )
    on conflict (owner_id, local_id)
    do update set
      deck_id = excluded.deck_id,
      deck_local_id = excluded.deck_local_id,
      card_name = excluded.card_name,
      normalized_name = excluded.normalized_name,
      oracle_id = excluded.oracle_id,
      scryfall_id = excluded.scryfall_id,
      variant = excluded.variant,
      quantity = excluded.quantity,
      sync_status = excluded.sync_status,
      client_updated_at = excluded.client_updated_at,
      last_synced_at = excluded.last_synced_at,
      deleted_at = excluded.deleted_at;
  end loop;

  update public.cloud_deck_card_stacks
  set
    sync_status = 'deleted',
    deleted_at = coalesce(deleted_at, sync_revision),
    client_updated_at = greatest(client_updated_at, sync_revision)
  where owner_id = acting_owner_id
    and deck_id = deck_cloud_id
    and deleted_at is null
    and (
      deck_status = 'deleted'
      or not (local_id = any(card_stack_local_ids))
    );

  get diagnostics tombstoned_card_stacks = row_count;

  select server_updated_at
  into deck_server_updated_at
  from public.cloud_decks
  where id = deck_cloud_id
    and owner_id = acting_owner_id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'deck_id', deck_cloud_id,
    'deck_local_id', deck_local_id,
    'deck_server_updated_at', deck_server_updated_at,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reconcile_store_reward_campaigns(p_store_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  today date := (now() at time zone 'utc')::date;
  released_tokens integer := 0;
begin
  perform 1
  from public.store_reward_campaigns
  where store_reward_campaigns.store_id = p_store_id
    and store_reward_campaigns.active
    and store_reward_campaigns.end_date < today
    and store_reward_campaigns.remaining_reserved_tokens > 0
  for update;

  select coalesce(sum(remaining_reserved_tokens), 0)
  into released_tokens
  from public.store_reward_campaigns
  where store_reward_campaigns.store_id = p_store_id
    and store_reward_campaigns.active
    and store_reward_campaigns.end_date < today
    and store_reward_campaigns.remaining_reserved_tokens > 0;

  if released_tokens > 0 then
    update public.store_token_wallets
    set
      available_tokens = available_tokens + released_tokens,
      reserved_giveaway_tokens = reserved_giveaway_tokens - released_tokens
    where store_token_wallets.store_id = p_store_id;
  end if;

  update public.store_reward_campaigns
  set
    active = false,
    disabled_at = coalesce(disabled_at, now()),
    remaining_reserved_tokens = 0
  where store_reward_campaigns.store_id = p_store_id
    and store_reward_campaigns.active
    and store_reward_campaigns.end_date < today;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_account_deletion_progress(p_request_id uuid, p_expected_user_id uuid, p_status text, p_error_code text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  job_row public.account_deletion_jobs;
begin
  if p_request_id is null or p_expected_user_id is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'INVALID_REQUEST', 'retryable', false);
  end if;

  select jobs.*
  into job_row
  from public.account_deletion_jobs as jobs
  where jobs.request_id = p_request_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'DELETION_JOB_NOT_FOUND', 'retryable', false);
  end if;

  if job_row.user_id is distinct from p_expected_user_id
     and job_row.user_fingerprint <> encode(
       extensions.digest(p_expected_user_id::text, 'sha256'),
       'hex'
     ) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'IDEMPOTENCY_TARGET_MISMATCH', 'retryable', false);
  end if;

  if p_status = 'needs_attention' then
    if p_error_code is null
       or char_length(p_error_code) not between 3 and 64
       or p_error_code !~ '^[A-Z0-9_]+$' then
      return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'INVALID_ERROR_CODE', 'retryable', false);
    end if;
    update public.account_deletion_jobs
    set status = 'needs_attention',
        last_error_code = p_error_code,
        updated_at = now()
    where id = job_row.id;
  elsif p_status = 'provider_cleaned' and job_row.database_cleaned_at is not null then
    update public.account_deletion_jobs
    set status = 'provider_cleaned',
        provider_cleaned_at = coalesce(provider_cleaned_at, now()),
        last_error_code = null,
        updated_at = now()
    where id = job_row.id;
  elsif p_status = 'auth_deleted'
        and job_row.database_cleaned_at is not null
        and job_row.provider_cleaned_at is not null then
    update public.account_deletion_jobs
    set status = 'auth_deleted',
        auth_deleted_at = coalesce(auth_deleted_at, now()),
        last_error_code = null,
        updated_at = now()
    where id = job_row.id;
  elsif p_status = 'complete'
        and job_row.database_cleaned_at is not null
        and job_row.provider_cleaned_at is not null
        and job_row.auth_deleted_at is not null then
    update public.account_deletion_jobs
    set status = 'complete',
        completed_at = coalesce(completed_at, now()),
        user_id = null,
        last_error_code = null,
        purge_after = least(purge_after, now() + interval '30 days'),
        updated_at = now()
    where id = job_row.id;
  elsif p_status = job_row.status then
    null;
  else
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', false,
      'code', 'INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION',
      'status', job_row.status,
      'retryable', false
    );
  end if;

  select jobs.*
  into job_row
  from public.account_deletion_jobs as jobs
  where jobs.request_id = p_request_id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'code', 'DELETION_PROGRESS_RECORDED',
    'request_id', p_request_id,
    'status', job_row.status,
    'retryable', false
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_connected_match_cost_event(p_session_id uuid, p_participant_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_event_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_event_units integer DEFAULT 1, p_is_realtime_relevant boolean DEFAULT false, p_estimated_write_count integer DEFAULT 1, p_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  session_record public.connected_match_sessions;
  event_name text := btrim(coalesce(p_event_type, ''));
  units integer := greatest(coalesce(p_event_units, 1), 1);
  write_count integer := greatest(coalesce(p_estimated_write_count, 0), 0);
begin
  if not public.connected_match_cost_telemetry_enabled() then
    return;
  end if;

  if p_session_id is null or event_name = '' then
    return;
  end if;

  select *
  into session_record
  from public.connected_match_sessions sessions
  where sessions.id = p_session_id;

  if session_record.id is null then
    return;
  end if;

  insert into public.connected_match_cost_events (
    session_id,
    participant_id,
    event_type,
    event_units,
    is_realtime_relevant,
    estimated_write_count,
    metadata
  )
  values (
    p_session_id,
    p_participant_id,
    event_name,
    units,
    coalesce(p_is_realtime_relevant, false),
    write_count,
    coalesce(p_metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
  );

  insert into public.connected_match_cost_rollups (
    session_id,
    game_date,
    game_month,
    participant_count,
    total_events,
    rpc_action_count,
    total_writes,
    realtime_writes,
    event_breakdown,
    cost_model_version,
    computed_at
  )
  values (
    p_session_id,
    (session_record.created_at at time zone 'utc')::date,
    date_trunc('month', session_record.created_at at time zone 'utc')::date,
    (
      select count(*)::integer
      from public.connected_match_participants participants
      where participants.session_id = p_session_id
    ),
    units,
    units,
    write_count,
    case when coalesce(p_is_realtime_relevant, false) then write_count else 0 end,
    jsonb_build_object(event_name, units),
    public.connected_match_cost_model_version(),
    now()
  )
  on conflict (session_id) do update set
    participant_count = (
      select count(*)::integer
      from public.connected_match_participants participants
      where participants.session_id = excluded.session_id
    ),
    total_events = connected_match_cost_rollups.total_events + excluded.total_events,
    rpc_action_count = connected_match_cost_rollups.rpc_action_count + excluded.rpc_action_count,
    total_writes = connected_match_cost_rollups.total_writes + excluded.total_writes,
    realtime_writes = connected_match_cost_rollups.realtime_writes + excluded.realtime_writes,
    event_breakdown = public.connected_match_cost_increment_breakdown(
      connected_match_cost_rollups.event_breakdown,
      event_name,
      units
    ),
    cost_model_version = public.connected_match_cost_model_version(),
    computed_at = now();
exception
  when others then
    -- Telemetry is best-effort and must never break active gameplay.
    return;
end;
$function$
