CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recover_stale_notification_digest_deliveries(p_stale_after_minutes integer DEFAULT 15, p_limit integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS TABLE(recovered_sent integer, reset_ready integer, marked_failed integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  normalized_stale_after_minutes integer :=
    least(greatest(coalesce(p_stale_after_minutes, 15), 1), 1440);
  normalized_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 100), 1), 100);
  stale_delivery_ids uuid[] := array[]::uuid[];
  sent_count integer := 0;
  ready_count integer := 0;
  failed_count integer := 0;
begin
  if auth.role() <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception 'Only the service role can recover notification digest deliveries.'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  select coalesce(array_agg(stale.id), array[]::uuid[])
  into stale_delivery_ids
  from (
    select notification_digest_deliveries.id
    from public.notification_digest_deliveries
    where notification_digest_deliveries.status = 'sending'
      and notification_digest_deliveries.claimed_at < (
        now() - make_interval(mins => normalized_stale_after_minutes)
      )
    order by
      notification_digest_deliveries.claimed_at asc nulls first,
      notification_digest_deliveries.created_at asc
    limit normalized_limit
    for update skip locked
  ) stale;

  with sent_updates as (
    update public.notification_digest_deliveries deliveries
    set
      status = 'sent',
      sent_at = coalesce(deliveries.sent_at, now()),
      failed_at = null,
      error_message = null,
      expo_ticket_count = greatest(
        deliveries.expo_ticket_count,
        (
          select count(*)::integer
          from public.notification_push_attempts attempts
          where attempts.delivery_id = deliveries.id
            and (
              attempts.status = 'ticket_ok'
              or attempts.expo_ticket_id is not null
            )
        )
      )
    where deliveries.id = any(stale_delivery_ids)
      and deliveries.status = 'sending'
      and exists (
        select 1
        from public.notification_push_attempts attempts
        where attempts.delivery_id = deliveries.id
          and (
            attempts.status = 'ticket_ok'
            or attempts.expo_ticket_id is not null
          )
      )
    returning deliveries.id
  )
  select count(*)::integer
  into sent_count
  from sent_updates;

  with ready_updates as (
    update public.notification_digest_deliveries deliveries
    set
      status = 'ready',
      claim_id = null,
      claimed_at = null,
      error_message = 'Recovered stale claim with no push attempts.'
    where deliveries.id = any(stale_delivery_ids)
      and deliveries.status = 'sending'
      and deliveries.attempt_count < 3
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from public.notification_push_attempts attempts
        where attempts.delivery_id = deliveries.id
      )
    returning deliveries.id
  )
  select count(*)::integer
  into ready_count
  from ready_updates;

  with failed_updates as (
    update public.notification_digest_deliveries deliveries
    set
      status = 'failed',
      failed_at = coalesce(deliveries.failed_at, now()),
      error_message = case
        when deliveries.attempt_count >= 3 then
          'Delivery failed after maximum attempts.'
        else
          'Stale sending delivery with failed push attempts.'
      end
    where deliveries.id = any(stale_delivery_ids)
      and deliveries.status = 'sending'
      and (
        deliveries.attempt_count >= 3
        or exists (
          select 1
          from public.notification_push_attempts attempts
          where attempts.delivery_id = deliveries.id
        )
      )
    returning deliveries.id
  )
  select count(*)::integer
  into failed_count
  from failed_updates;

  return query
  select sent_count, ready_count, failed_count;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_connected_match_cost_rollup(p_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  session_record public.connected_match_sessions;
  existing_rollup public.connected_match_cost_rollups;
  event_totals record;
  participant_total integer := 0;
  duration_value integer := 0;
  writes_per_minute_value numeric := 0;
  estimated_cost numeric := 0;
  breakdown jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
begin
  if auth.uid() is not null and not public.is_super_admin() then
    if not exists (
      select 1
      from public.connected_match_participants participants
      where participants.session_id = p_session_id
        and participants.user_id = auth.uid()
    ) then
      raise exception 'You are not allowed to refresh this Connected Match cost rollup.'
        using errcode = '42501';
    end if;
  end if;

  select *
  into session_record
  from public.connected_match_sessions sessions
  where sessions.id = p_session_id;

  if session_record.id is null then
    raise exception 'Connected Match not found.'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  select *
  into existing_rollup
  from public.connected_match_cost_rollups rollups
  where rollups.session_id = p_session_id;

  select
    coalesce(sum(events.event_units), 0)::integer as total_events,
    coalesce(sum(events.event_units), 0)::integer as rpc_action_count,
    coalesce(sum(events.estimated_write_count), 0)::integer as total_writes,
    coalesce(sum(events.estimated_write_count) filter (where events.is_realtime_relevant), 0)::integer as realtime_writes,
    coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(event_counts.event_type, event_counts.total_units), '{}'::jsonb) as event_breakdown
  into event_totals
  from public.connected_match_cost_events events
  left join (
    select
      grouped.event_type,
      sum(grouped.event_units)::integer as total_units
    from public.connected_match_cost_events grouped
    where grouped.session_id = p_session_id
    group by grouped.event_type
  ) event_counts
    on event_counts.event_type = events.event_type
  where events.session_id = p_session_id;

  if event_totals.event_breakdown is null then
    breakdown := '{}'::jsonb;
  else
    breakdown := event_totals.event_breakdown;
  end if;

  if coalesce(existing_rollup.heartbeat_count, 0) > 0 then
    breakdown := jsonb_set(
      breakdown,
      '{heartbeat}',
      to_jsonb(existing_rollup.heartbeat_count),
      true
    );
  end if;

  if coalesce(existing_rollup.reconnect_count, 0) > 0 then
    breakdown := jsonb_set(
      breakdown,
      '{participant_reconnected}',
      to_jsonb(existing_rollup.reconnect_count),
      true
    );
  end if;

  select count(*)::integer
  into participant_total
  from public.connected_match_participants participants
  where participants.session_id = p_session_id;

  duration_value := greatest(
    extract(epoch from (
      coalesce(session_record.completed_at, now()) -
      coalesce(session_record.started_at, session_record.created_at)
    ))::integer,
    0
  );

  writes_per_minute_value :=
    (
      coalesce(event_totals.total_writes, 0)
      + coalesce(existing_rollup.heartbeat_count, 0)
      + coalesce(existing_rollup.reconnect_count, 0)
    )::numeric
    / greatest(duration_value::numeric / 60, 1);

  estimated_cost := public.connected_match_cost_estimate(
    coalesce(event_totals.total_writes, 0)
      + coalesce(existing_rollup.heartbeat_count, 0)
      + coalesce(existing_rollup.reconnect_count, 0),
    coalesce(event_totals.realtime_writes, 0)
      + coalesce(existing_rollup.heartbeat_count, 0)
      + coalesce(existing_rollup.reconnect_count, 0),
    coalesce(existing_rollup.heartbeat_count, 0),
    session_record.status = 'completed'
  );

  insert into public.connected_match_cost_rollups (
    session_id,
    game_date,
    game_month,
    participant_count,
    duration_seconds,
    total_events,
    rpc_action_count,
    total_writes,
    realtime_writes,
    heartbeat_count,
    reconnect_count,
    writes_per_minute,
    estimated_operational_cost_usd,
    event_breakdown,
    cost_model_version,
    computed_at
  )
  values (
    p_session_id,
    (session_record.created_at at time zone 'utc')::date,
    date_trunc('month', session_record.created_at at time zone 'utc')::date,
    participant_total,
    duration_value,
    coalesce(event_totals.total_events, 0),
    coalesce(event_totals.rpc_action_count, 0),
    coalesce(event_totals.total_writes, 0)
      + coalesce(existing_rollup.heartbeat_count, 0)
      + coalesce(existing_rollup.reconnect_count, 0),
    coalesce(event_totals.realtime_writes, 0)
      + coalesce(existing_rollup.heartbeat_count, 0)
      + coalesce(existing_rollup.reconnect_count, 0),
    coalesce(existing_rollup.heartbeat_count, 0),
    coalesce(existing_rollup.reconnect_count, 0),
    writes_per_minute_value,
    estimated_cost,
    breakdown,
    public.connected_match_cost_model_version(),
    now()
  )
  on conflict (session_id) do update set
    game_date = excluded.game_date,
    game_month = excluded.game_month,
    participant_count = excluded.participant_count,
    duration_seconds = excluded.duration_seconds,
    total_events = excluded.total_events,
    rpc_action_count = excluded.rpc_action_count,
    total_writes = excluded.total_writes,
    realtime_writes = excluded.realtime_writes,
    heartbeat_count = excluded.heartbeat_count,
    reconnect_count = excluded.reconnect_count,
    writes_per_minute = excluded.writes_per_minute,
    estimated_operational_cost_usd = excluded.estimated_operational_cost_usd,
    event_breakdown = excluded.event_breakdown,
    cost_model_version = excluded.cost_model_version,
    computed_at = excluded.computed_at;

  return (
    select row_to_json(rollups)::jsonb
    from public.connected_match_cost_rollups rollups
    where rollups.session_id = p_session_id
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.select_store_reward_campaign_winner(p_store_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(ok boolean, already_selected boolean, campaign_id uuid, store_id uuid, reward_date date, user_id uuid, display_name text, username text, token_amount integer, selected_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  today date := (now() at time zone 'utc')::date;
  campaign public.store_reward_campaigns;
  existing_award public.store_reward_campaign_daily_awards;
  winner_checkin public.store_checkins;
  reward_id uuid;
  selected_award public.store_reward_campaign_daily_awards;
  winner_profile record;
  active_store_id uuid;
begin
  if auth.role() <> 'service_role'
    and not public.is_store_staff(p_store_id)
  then
    raise exception 'You are not authorized to select this store reward winner.'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  select stores.id
  into active_store_id
  from public.stores
  where stores.id = p_store_id
    and stores.is_active;

  if active_store_id is null then
    raise exception 'Reward winners can only be selected for an active store.'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  perform public.reconcile_store_reward_campaigns(p_store_id);

  select *
  into campaign
  from public.store_reward_campaigns
  where store_reward_campaigns.store_id = p_store_id
    and store_reward_campaigns.active
    and store_reward_campaigns.start_date <= today
    and store_reward_campaigns.end_date >= today
  order by store_reward_campaigns.created_at desc
  limit 1
  for update;

  if campaign.id is null then
    raise exception 'No active reward campaign is available for today.'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  select *
  into existing_award
  from public.store_reward_campaign_daily_awards
  where store_reward_campaign_daily_awards.campaign_id = campaign.id
    and store_reward_campaign_daily_awards.reward_date = today;

  if existing_award.id is not null then
    select profiles.display_name, profiles.username_display
    into winner_profile
    from public.profiles
    where profiles.user_id = existing_award.user_id;

    return query
    select
      true,
      true,
      existing_award.campaign_id,
      existing_award.store_id,
      existing_award.reward_date,
      existing_award.user_id,
      winner_profile.display_name,
      winner_profile.username_display,
      existing_award.token_amount,
      existing_award.selected_at;
    return;
  end if;

  if campaign.remaining_reserved_tokens < campaign.daily_reward_amount then
    raise exception 'Campaign does not have enough reserved tokens remaining.'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  select *
  into winner_checkin
  from public.store_checkins
  where store_checkins.store_id = p_store_id
    and store_checkins.check_in_date = today
  order by random()
  limit 1;

  if winner_checkin.id is null then
    raise exception 'No checked-in players are eligible for today yet.'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  insert into public.user_token_wallets (user_id)
  values (winner_checkin.user_id)
  on conflict (user_id) do nothing;

  update public.user_token_wallets
  set
    token_balance = token_balance + campaign.daily_reward_amount,
    lifetime_granted = lifetime_granted + campaign.daily_reward_amount
  where user_token_wallets.user_id = winner_checkin.user_id;

  insert into public.store_rewards (
    store_id,
    user_id,
    checkin_id,
    source,
    token_amount,
    reason,
    awarded_by,
    metadata
  )
  values (
    p_store_id,
    winner_checkin.user_id,
    winner_checkin.id,
    'random_giveaway',
    campaign.daily_reward_amount,
    'Daily Store Check-In Reward Campaign winner',
    auth.uid(),
    jsonb_build_object('campaign_id', campaign.id, 'reward_date', today)
  )
  returning id into reward_id;

  insert into public.store_reward_campaign_daily_awards (
    campaign_id,
    store_id,
    reward_date,
    checkin_id,
    user_id,
    token_amount,
    store_reward_id
  )
  values (
    campaign.id,
    p_store_id,
    today,
    winner_checkin.id,
    winner_checkin.user_id,
    campaign.daily_reward_amount,
    reward_id
  )
  returning * into selected_award;

  update public.store_reward_campaigns
  set
    remaining_reserved_tokens = remaining_reserved_tokens - campaign.daily_reward_amount,
    active = case
      when remaining_reserved_tokens - campaign.daily_reward_amount <= 0
        or end_date <= today
      then false
      else active
    end,
    disabled_at = case
      when remaining_reserved_tokens - campaign.daily_reward_amount <= 0
        or end_date <= today
      then now()
      else disabled_at
    end
  where store_reward_campaigns.id = campaign.id;

  update public.store_token_wallets
  set
    reserved_giveaway_tokens = reserved_giveaway_tokens - campaign.daily_reward_amount,
    lifetime_awarded = lifetime_awarded + campaign.daily_reward_amount
  where store_token_wallets.store_id = p_store_id;

  select profiles.display_name, profiles.username_display
  into winner_profile
  from public.profiles
  where profiles.user_id = selected_award.user_id;

  return query
  select
    true,
    false,
    selected_award.campaign_id,
    selected_award.store_id,
    selected_award.reward_date,
    selected_award.user_id,
    winner_profile.display_name,
    winner_profile.username_display,
    selected_award.token_amount,
    selected_award.selected_at;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_connected_match_ready(p_session_id uuid, p_player jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  player_payload record;
  participant_record public.connected_match_participants;
begin
  if current_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication is required to ready up.'
      using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  select *
  into player_payload
  from public.connected_match_build_player_payload(coalesce(p_player, '{}'::jsonb), current_user_id)
  limit 1;

  update public.connected_match_participants participants
  set
    display_name = player_payload.display_name,
    avatar_ref = player_payload.avatar_ref,
    commander_name = player_payload.commander_name,
    commander_scryfall_id = player_payload.commander_scryfall_id,
    commander_image_url = player_payload.commander_image_url,
    commander_art_crop_url = player_payload.commander_art_crop_url,
    is_ready = true,
    ready_at = coalesce(participants.ready_at, now()),
    last_seen_at = now(),
    reconnect_until = now() + interval '30 minutes'
  where participants.session_id = p_session_id
    and participants.user_id = current_user_id
  returning *
  into participant_record;

  if participant_record.id is null then
    raise exception 'You are not part of this Connected Match.'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  return row_to_json(participant_record)::jsonb;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_friend_bulk_sharing(friend_user_id uuid, shares_bulk boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update public.friend_requests
  set requester_shares_bulk = coalesce(shares_bulk, false)
  where requester_id = auth.uid()
    and recipient_id = friend_user_id
    and status = 'accepted';

  if found then
    return;
  end if;

  update public.friend_requests
  set recipient_shares_bulk = coalesce(shares_bulk, false)
  where recipient_id = auth.uid()
    and requester_id = friend_user_id
    and status = 'accepted';

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Accepted friendship was not found.';
  end if;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.start_connected_match(p_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  session_record public.connected_match_sessions;
  first_player_id uuid;
  participant_count integer;
  ready_participant_count integer;
begin
  if current_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication is required to start a Connected Match.'
      using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  select *
  into session_record
  from public.connected_match_sessions sessions
  where sessions.id = p_session_id
  for update;

  if session_record.id is null then
    raise exception 'Connected Match not found.'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  if session_record.host_user_id <> current_user_id then
    raise exception 'Only the host can start this Connected Match.'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if session_record.status <> 'lobby' then
    raise exception 'This Connected Match cannot be started.'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  select
    count(*),
    count(*) filter (where participants.is_ready)
  into participant_count, ready_participant_count
  from public.connected_match_participants participants
  where participants.session_id = p_session_id
    and participants.terminal_state = 'active';

  if participant_count < 2 then
    raise exception 'At least two players are required to start a Connected Match.'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  if ready_participant_count <> participant_count then
    raise exception 'Every player must be ready before starting a Connected Match.'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  select participants.id
  into first_player_id
  from public.connected_match_participants participants
  where participants.session_id = p_session_id
    and participants.terminal_state = 'active'
    and participants.is_ready
  order by random()
  limit 1;

  insert into public.connected_match_commander_damage (
    session_id,
    target_participant_id,
    source_participant_id
  )
  select
    p_session_id,
    target.id,
    source.id
  from public.connected_match_participants target
  join public.connected_match_participants source
    on source.session_id = target.session_id
   and source.id <> target.id
  where target.session_id = p_session_id
    and target.terminal_state = 'active'
    and source.terminal_state = 'active'
  on conflict (session_id, target_participant_id, source_participant_id) do nothing;

  update public.connected_match_sessions
  set
    status = 'active',
    first_player_participant_id = first_player_id,
    started_at = now(),
    expires_at = now() + interval '36 hours'
  where id = p_session_id
  returning *
  into session_record;

  insert into public.connected_match_events (
    session_id,
    participant_id,
    event_type,
    payload
  )
  values (
    p_session_id,
    first_player_id,
    'match_started',
    jsonb_build_object('first_player_participant_id', first_player_id)
  );

  return row_to_json(session_record)::jsonb;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_store_daily_push_message(p_store_id uuid, p_message text, p_enabled boolean)
 RETURNS TABLE(store_id uuid, store_name text, message text, enabled boolean, updated_at timestamp with time zone, last_sent_date date)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  normalized_message text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_message, '')), '');
  next_enabled boolean := coalesce(p_enabled, false);
  updated_store record;
begin
  if current_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication is required to update the Store Daily Push Message.'
      using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  if normalized_message is not null
    and char_length(normalized_message) > 160
  then
    raise exception 'Store Daily Push Message must be 160 characters or fewer.'
      using errcode = '22001';
  end if;

  select stores.id
  into updated_store
  from public.stores
  where stores.id = p_store_id
    and stores.is_active;

  if updated_store.id is null then
    raise exception 'Store Daily Push Message can only be updated for an active store.'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  if not public.is_store_staff(p_store_id) then
    raise exception 'You are not authorized to update this Store Daily Push Message.'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  update public.stores
  set
    store_daily_push_message = normalized_message,
    store_daily_push_message_enabled = next_enabled and normalized_message is not null,
    store_daily_push_message_updated_at = now()
  where stores.id = p_store_id
  returning
    stores.id,
    stores.name,
    stores.store_daily_push_message,
    stores.store_daily_push_message_enabled,
    stores.store_daily_push_message_updated_at,
    stores.store_daily_push_last_sent_date
  into updated_store;

  return query
  select
    updated_store.id,
    updated_store.name,
    updated_store.store_daily_push_message,
    updated_store.store_daily_push_message_enabled,
    updated_store.store_daily_push_message_updated_at,
    updated_store.store_daily_push_last_sent_date;
end;
$function$
